title: Make your units intelligent with custom paths
features:
Tired of the game's crappy unit movement system? Why not make them more intelligent using this!

[ HOW TO USE ]
Create a path by placing nodes which the units will follow. The order of placement will be the order in which units follow first (Just look at labels above)

[ FEATURES ]
-> Can create up to four paths (Units will go to the nearest first node)
-> Delete the current path selected (Do note that units following that path will just stop)
-> Move all Units (Make all units follow the nearest path)
-> Auto March (All units that are spawned will follow the nearest path)
-> Destroy all paths (Do note that units following the paths will just stop)
-> The spreading of the units (How much you want to spread your units out, smaller number means they are closer together)
-> Auto-shoot where they will destroy anything blocking their way
